# Twiinn AI

> Twiinn AI is a SaaS marketplace where influencers and creators build AI chatbot clones of themselves. Fans subscribe monthly to chat with these AI twins 24/7. Creators keep 85-90% of subscription revenue.

## What is Twiinn AI?

Twiinn AI lets content creators (fitness coaches, finance experts, beauty influencers, tech educators, etc.) create an AI-powered chatbot trained on their content — videos, posts, podcasts, and more. The AI twin thinks, talks, and advises like the creator. Fans pay a monthly subscription to access personalized conversations with the AI twin anytime.

## How it works

1. **Create** — Upload your content or connect your social accounts. We train an AI that mirrors your personality, expertise, and communication style.
2. **Launch** — Set your subscription price ($9.99–$49.99/month). Your AI twin goes live and is available 24/7.
3. **Earn** — Fans subscribe to chat with your twin. You keep 85–90% of every subscription. We handle payments, hosting, and AI infrastructure.

## Business model

- Creators set their own subscription price
- Platform commission: 10–15% (early creators get 0% for 6 months)
- Fans get unlimited conversations with subscribed twins
- Average creator earnings: $2K–$8K/month depending on audience size

## Key features

- AI trained on creator's actual content and personality
- 24/7 availability — the twin never sleeps
- Full creator control — set limits, review conversations, block topics
- Real-time chat with streaming responses
- Creator dashboard with earnings, subscribers, and message analytics
